_about: The journal: things worth remembering, each unlocked once from the record and kept on the Books page. 'stat' names the stat and 'at' the count; 'flag' is a named check in scripts/extras.gd.

achievements.name: First one done
achievements.blurb: A job finished, start to end.

achievements.name: Old hand
achievements.blurb: Fifty jobs. The truck knows the way.

achievements.name: Soft hands
achievements.blurb: Three clean jobs in a row: nothing scuffed, nothing dropped, nobody shoved.

achievements.name: Surgeon
achievements.blurb: Ten clean jobs in a row.

achievements.name: Defenestrated
achievements.blurb: Out the window. There is a word for it.

achievements.name: Second floor
achievements.blurb: Out an upstairs window. Four nights in St. Bridget's.

achievements.name: The bigger person
achievements.blurb: Forgave someone who put you through a window.

achievements.name: Small claims
achievements.blurb: Won a claim over a shove.

achievements.name: Something is purring
achievements.blurb: Found the cat in the box.

achievements.name: Maker
achievements.blurb: Ten things made at the bench.

achievements.name: Sundries
achievements.blurb: Caught an accountant with a hand in the jar.

achievements.name: Heirloom
achievements.blurb: Delivered an heirloom without a mark.

achievements.name: On the clock
achievements.blurb: Made a rush job on time.

achievements.name: Top of the league
achievements.blurb: Topped the Movers' League for a week.
